title: Ferry Street Brewing: the autumn tap list is live
preheaderText: Five new pours on Ferry Street. Small-batch ales brewed by the river, poured fresh in the taproom this week.
heroImageAlt: A full pour of amber ale on the taproom bar beside the taps
heroText: Five new pours came off the line this week. Small batches, brewed slow in copper by the water, and poured the same day at the bar on Ferry Street.
leadHeadline: We brew in small runs, pour it fresh, and never ship a beer we would not drink at the bar ourselves.
tap1Text: Bright, dry pilsners and pale ales. Cold-conditioned for a snappy finish.
tap2Text: Ambers, browns, and bocks. Toasted grain, caramel, a soft round body.
tap3Text: Stouts and porters. Coffee, cocoa, and a long roasted finish.
gal1Alt: A pale golden ale in a tasting glass
gal2Alt: A deep amber lager in a tasting glass
gal3Alt: A dark roasted stout in a tasting glass
ctaText: The taproom is open Thursday through Sunday. First pour is on us when you show this email at the bar.
storyText: We brew the way the mill crew did a century back. Open the mash by hand, watch the boil, let it condition until it is ready. No shortcuts, no filler, no rush.
storyImageAlt: Rows of oak conditioning barrels in the brewhouse
